statement: The function returns a result r such that, for every vertex v with 0 <= v < n, v occurs in r if and only if there is no index i with 0 <= i < len(edges) and edges[i][1] = v; furthermore, every element of r lies in [0,n) and no vertex occurs more than once in r.
preconditions: 2 <= n <= 100000; 1 <= len(edges) <= min(100000, n*(n-1)/2); for every i with 0 <= i < len(edges), len(edges[i]) = 2, 0 <= edges[i][0] < n, and 0 <= edges[i][1] < n; all ordered pairs (edges[i][0], edges[i][1]) are distinct; and the directed graph on vertices 0,1,...,n-1 with these directed edges is acyclic.

statement: The function returns a result r; it does not fail, overflow, or panic.
preconditions: 2 <= n <= 100000; 1 <= len(edges) <= min(100000, n*(n-1)/2); for every i with 0 <= i < len(edges), len(edges[i]) = 2, 0 <= edges[i][0] < n, and 0 <= edges[i][1] < n; all ordered pairs (edges[i][0], edges[i][1]) are distinct; and the directed graph on vertices 0,1,...,n-1 with these directed edges is acyclic.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every vertex v with 0 <= v < n, there exists j with 0 <= j < len(r) such that v is reachable from r[j], where a vertex t is reachable from a vertex s if either s = t (zero-length path) or there are k >= 1 and vertices s = v0, v1, ..., vk = t with each ordered pair (v_{h-1}, v_h) appearing in edges for 1 <= h <= k.
preconditions: 2 <= n <= 100000; 1 <= len(edges) <= min(100000, n*(n-1)/2); for every i with 0 <= i < len(edges), len(edges[i]) = 2, 0 <= edges[i][0] < n, and 0 <= edges[i][1] < n; all ordered pairs (edges[i][0], edges[i][1]) are distinct; and the directed graph on vertices 0,1,...,n-1 with these directed edges is acyclic.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, there is no list S such that (i) every element of S is an integer v with 0 <= v < n, (ii) no vertex occurs more than once in S, (iii) len(S) < len(r), and (iv) for every vertex v with 0 <= v < n, v is reachable from some element of S, where t is reachable from s if either s = t or there are k >= 1 and vertices s = v0, v1, ..., vk = t with each ordered pair (v_{h-1}, v_h) appearing in edges for 1 <= h <= k.
preconditions: 2 <= n <= 100000; 1 <= len(edges) <= min(100000, n*(n-1)/2); for every i with 0 <= i < len(edges), len(edges[i]) = 2, 0 <= edges[i][0] < n, and 0 <= edges[i][1] < n; all ordered pairs (edges[i][0], edges[i][1]) are distinct; and the directed graph on vertices 0,1,...,n-1 with these directed edges is acyclic.
